name: mutagen
scope: Untagged MPEG Layer III frame headers: version, layer, sample rate, channels, bitrate; duration from Xing/Info/VBRI if present, otherwise stream bytes divided by the header bitrate. No audio decoding.
family_note: Same package, release and mutagen/mp3 module as the mp3_id3v2/python mutagen entry. That entry checks ID3v2 frames; this one requires no tags and checks MPEGInfo from the frame headers. It is a separate parsed scope, not an independent parser family.

name: tinytag
scope: Untagged MPEG Layer III frame headers walked by TinyTag's own _MPEG class: sample rate, channels, mean bitrate of the first five frames, and duration estimated from stream size and mean frame length when no Xing/Info/VBRI header is present. No MPEG version, layer or frame count is exposed. No audio decoding.
family_note: Independent pure-Python code in tinytag/tinytag.py; it does not use Mutagen. Its _ID3 class handles tagged files and hands the audio to the same _MPEG class; this entry requires the untagged _MPEG path and zero _ID3 lines.
independent_expectation: controls/mp3/check_controls.py header walk: 11 frames x 1152 samples at 44.1 kHz mono, 64 kbit/s; 12 frames x 576 samples at 22.05 kHz stereo, 32 kbit/s. duration_us = round(frames x samples_per_frame / sample_rate x 10^6).

name: hachoir
scope: Untagged MPEG Layer III streams walked frame by frame by hachoir's own mpeg_audio parser: every frame[] field set decodes the 32-bit header (version, layer, bit-rate index, sampling-rate index, padding, channel mode, emphasis) and its length; the harness requires the frames to cover the whole input with one header tuple. Reports version, layer, sample rate, bitrate, channel mode, channels and frame count. No audio or side-information decoding.
family_note: Independent pure-Python code in hachoir/parser/audio/mpeg_audio.py on hachoir's own field/stream framework; it does not use Mutagen or TinyTag. Its ID3v1/ID3v2 parsers live in hachoir/parser/audio/id3.py; this entry requires zero id3.py lines. The parser class is chosen explicitly: hachoir's own guessParser dispatch, MIME tags and the disabled magic table are not exercised or credited.
independent_expectation: controls/mp3/check_controls.py header walk (11 frames, MPEG-1, 44.1 kHz mono, 64 kbit/s; 12 frames, MPEG-2, 22.05 kHz stereo, 32 kbit/s; frame lengths sum to the file size) plus channel-mode bits read from byte 3 of every header by scripts/verify_python_mp3_hachoir_feedback.py.
